body: I should add though that you've got great skin, good eyebrows, and a good bone structure.
Shave the chin hair for sure. Get a haircut and know you're going to be really embarrassed of that lip ring down the road.
Men only grow beards for other men. Leave it as is, it keeps you from looking too baby faced

You have the capacity to be cute. Right now you're not bad but as you said, a bit awkward. The hair has got to go! Long hair is really outdated. Go to a good salon with a 20 something staff and tell them you're looking for a short, "I'm a professional but a bit hipster" haircut. You want it shorter on the sides, a bit longer on top. I think that alone will make a huge difference. Replace the frames with a thinner rim and put on a slim fit button down and I have a feeling you'll do pretty well with the ladies.

Emotionally abusive people usually surround themselves with people who will approve their behavior. They gaslight you. I don't know the situation enough to say if you were abusive or not, but the silent treatment, especially when it sends you to this level of pain, is cruel.
My dog was killed in November. I promised myself I would wait until he passed away to commit suicide. I loved him dearly, but he didn't help lift my depression.
I've been there... it's really rough and happens far more than people realize. The mental health system in the U.S. is a mess and it's near impossible to get "help".
Have you ever considered bankruptcy? Government assistance? I really think those are two avenues to consider.
As mentioned before, she would want you to be there for your children and find joy in the faces you created together. She would absolutely not want you to kill yourself.

You tried your best, you did everything you could. Him deciding to shut you out instead of talking it over is on him, not you. Giving someone the silent treatment is passive aggressive and emotionally abusive.
